page.layout: One page of running text in a single column; short marginal notes in the right margin beside lines 2, 3 and 4 and beside the last paragraph. Page number at the top right. Signature "O 2" at the foot.

l.i: Christum Dominum vendidit & tradidit. Nos vero eum vobis vendimus & non tradimus.

main_text.l: Erat & Antuerpiæ & in finitimis locis hoc
generis, qui tum primùm aliquem verbi Dei
doctrinæ facem intulit hoc anno primus,
Henricus Cramerus Esensis, pastor in urbe
conius die Palmarum docere cœpit Evangelium.
Die igitur passionis Domini ibidem excom-
egit, quod ex Ægyptiaca servitute liberatus sit:
Cygnaeae in Misnia cœpit hoc anno ex
lii, ex qua urbe ἐξ[illegible, ~3 letters] Fridericus Myconius
ad Annæmontanos ea scripsit quorum modo

page.notes: Right margin notes: "Hamelmannus." (beside line 2, printed as "mannus" with a partly smudged letter) and "Vita Myconii." (three times). The Greek word after "urbe" is only partly legible and is marked as illegible. The page number is read as 211 from a worn "2ii". The watermark "Digitized by Google" is excluded.
